page.description: Zorin OS editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: An Ubuntu-based desktop built to look familiar to people leaving Windows or macOS. Core is the free edition; Pro, Education and Lite are separate images.
pros: Desktop layouts that mimic Windows or macOS out of the box.
Ubuntu LTS base with the usual package and driver support.
Free Core image; paid Pro adds layouts and extra software.
cons: The free Core image is one edition; Pro and Education need a purchase.
Downloads go through a mirror picker; this page pins one official mirror.
x86_64 only for the pinned image.
page.previewNote: A stock screenshot of Zorin OS 17.3 from Wikimedia Commons. It is not 18.1 and not a ROMinit recording: no image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted for this page.

shot.alt: Zorin OS 17.3 desktop with the taskbar and application menu
shot.caption: Stock screenshot of Zorin OS 17.3 · not 18.1, no USB written, no boot tested.

page.status: One path for the free edition: the Core 64-bit ISO from an official mirror, written with dd or any image writer. Writing erases the stick; the installer then partitions or erases the target disk.
